snippet.title: You Should Be Using Jev’s Browser Agent, Here’s Why
snippet.description:
🚀Join the Agentic Academy: https://skool.com/scrapes
Grab the Jev Browser doc here: https://skool.com/scrapesai
👀 Get Customers from ChatGPT: https://dub.sh/rankspot-yt
Don't miss the next build - https://www.youtube.com/@simonscrapes?sub_confirmation=1

Traditional browser agents are slow, often taking 10-20 minutes for a simple task. In this video, I'll show you how to use Jev's Browser Agent to make decisions in a fraction of a second. We'll cover how it works by combining Jev's fast classification with Claude's reasoning, and I'll walk you through building your own with a single prompt.

00:00 - The Problem With Browser Agents
02:06 - The Trick To Making It Fast
07:28 - Building Your Own Agent
09:08 - Where This Approach Fails
11:47 - Recap
